scripts.reports:artifacts: pnpm --silent capabilities:json > interop-capabilities.json && pnpm --silent scaffold:json > interop-scaffold.json && pnpm --silent probes:json > interop-probes.json && pnpm --silent promotion:json > interop-promotion.json
scripts.test:ci: pnpm typecheck && X402_INTEROP_PROFILE=reference-spine X402_INTEROP_REFERENCE=rust pnpm test:smoke && X402_INTEROP_PROFILE=reference-spine X402_INTEROP_REFERENCE=rust pnpm test:multi-currency && X402_INTEROP_PROFILE=reference-spine X402_INTEROP_REFERENCE=rust pnpm test:boundaries
scripts.test:experimental: vitest run test/capabilities.test.ts test/contracts.test.ts test/report-cli.test.ts test/scaffold.test.ts test/lua-scaffold.test.ts test/promotion.test.ts test/upto-fixtures.test.ts test/batch-settlement-fixtures.test.ts test/session-fixtures.test.ts test/subscription-fixtures.test.ts test/planned-adapters.test.ts
scripts.test:multi-currency: vitest run test/e2e.test.ts --testNamePattern "picks PYUSD|falls back to USDC"
scripts.test:probe:local: pnpm test:ci && pnpm test:probe:staging && pnpm test:probe:reports
scripts.test:probe:staging: pnpm test:probe:planned-syntax && pnpm test:probe:lua-static && pnpm test:probe:usage-boundaries && pnpm test:probe:planned-runtime
scripts.test:probe:reports: pnpm capabilities && pnpm capabilities:json && pnpm scaffold && pnpm scaffold:json && pnpm probes && pnpm probes:json && pnpm promotion && pnpm promotion:json && pnpm reports:verify
scripts.test:probe:planned-syntax: pnpm test:probe:python-syntax && pnpm test:probe:python-unit && pnpm test:probe:go-build && pnpm test:probe:ruby-syntax && pnpm test:probe:ruby-unit && pnpm test:probe:php-syntax && pnpm test:probe:php-unit && pnpm test:probe:php-composer
scripts.test:probe:usage-boundaries: pnpm test:probe:upto-fixtures && pnpm test:probe:typescript-upto-server && pnpm test:probe:rust-upto-server && pnpm test:probe:batch-settlement-fixtures && pnpm test:probe:session-fixtures && pnpm test:probe:subscription-fixtures && vitest run test/contracts.test.ts
scripts.test:probe:typescript-upto-server: cd ../../typescript/packages/x402 && pnpm exec vitest run test/unit/upto-server.test.ts test/unit/compatibility.test.ts
scripts.test:probe:python-unit: cd ../../python && PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m unittest discover -s tests
scripts.test:probe:lua-syntax: cd ../../lua && if command -v luac >/dev/null 2>&1; then luac -p bin/interop-server.lua; elif command -v lua >/dev/null 2>&1; then lua -e 'assert(loadfile("bin/interop-server.lua"))'; else echo 'Lua toolchain not found; install lua or luac to run this probe' >&2; exit 127; fi
